alvo.gramatica: buy her / give him + presente · for her / for him
alvo.foco: escolher presentes com buy her, give him e for her (gift, wrap, her, him, flower, birthday)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende presentes: Buy her a flower. Give him a book. I’ll wrap it for her.
falas: Tom, it is her birthday tomorrow.
What gift can I buy her?
Buy her a flower.

alvo.gramatica: Who is it for? · It is for… · It is from…
alvo.foco: perguntar para quem é e de quem veio com Who is it for? e It is from… (parcel, ribbon, card, tree, nutcracker, sleigh)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar para quem é: Who is this gift for? It is for my mother. It is from my brother.
falas: Godfather, who is this parcel for?
It is for you, Clara. It is from me.
And who is the card from?

alvo.gramatica: no matter how / what… · however…
alvo.foco: falar de determinação com no matter how, no matter what e however (dream, doubt, patience, trouble, crowd, win)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a persistir apesar de tudo: No matter what happens, keep your dream. However hard it is, do not doubt yourself. No matter how long it takes, h
falas: My son, no matter what happens, keep your dream.
But I have doubts, Father.
However hard it is, do not doubt yourself.

alvo.gramatica: How much do I owe? · leave a tip of ten percent
alvo.foco: pagar a conta e a gorjeta com How much do I owe? e a tip of ten percent (tip, owe, percent, service, total, leave)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a pagar: How much do I owe? The total is fifty dollars. Leave a tip of ten percent.
falas: Excuse me, how much do I owe?
The total is fifty dollars.
Is the service included?

alvo.gramatica: always · usually · often · rarely · never + verbo
alvo.foco: falar de hábitos com always, usually, often, rarely e never (often, rarely, skip, usually, always, never)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende frequência: I usually fish at dawn. I often eat fish. I rarely skip lunch. I never skip dinner.
alvo.obra_atual: The Old Man and the Sea
falas: Do you always fish in the morning?
I usually fish at dawn.
Do you often skip lunch?

alvo.gramatica: during + substantivo · for + duração · while + frase
alvo.foco: diferenciar during, for e while ao contar um acidente (dice, board, monkey, stampede, vines, drums)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende três palavras de tempo: during the game, for two hours, while I was running.
falas: Alan, what happened during the game?
A monkey appeared while I was rolling the dice.
How long did you play for?

alvo.gramatica: plural irregular: tooth → teeth · foot → feet · child → children
alvo.foco: usar plurais irregulares: tooth → teeth, foot → feet, mouse → mice, child → children (tooth, feet, dreams, mice, women, eyes)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende plurais irregulares: one tooth, two teeth; one foot, two feet; one mouse, two mice; one child, two children.
falas: BFG, your feet are huge! How many toes do you have?
Ten toes on two big feet, little Sophie.
And what about the other giants’ teeth?

alvo.gramatica: must · is required to · is optional
alvo.foco: separar o que é exigido do que é opcional com must e is required to (governess, mansion, references, lessons, experience, evening)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende regras do anúncio: You must send a resume. You are required to speak English. A cover letter is optional.
falas: Miss Eyre, a governess must teach every morning.
I understand. Are references required?
Yes, they are required. You must bring them in writing.

alvo.gramatica: What if we… ? · We could… · How about…ing
alvo.foco: sugerir um plano com What if we e We could (magnifying glass, clue, secret passage, eerie, suggestion, trapdoor)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a sugerir: What if we look for a clue? We could use the magnifying glass.
falas: It is eerie in here.
What if we look for a clue?
We could use the magnifying glass.

alvo.gramatica: Do you mind if I…? · Is it okay if I…?
alvo.foco: pedir licença com Do you mind if I e Is it okay if I (scooter, gelato, haircut, newspaper, steps, camera)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a pedir licença: Do you mind if I leave early? Is it okay if I take tomorrow off?
falas: Do you mind if I sit here, Joe?
Not at all. Is it okay if I read the newspaper?
Of course. Do you mind if I try the gelato?

alvo.gramatica: leave a message · call back later · take a message
alvo.foco: deixar recado com Can I leave a message e Could you call back later (alien, spaceship, bike, closet, candy, signal)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende recados: Can I leave a message? Could you call back later? I will take a message.
falas: Hello? Oh, hi. Elliott is not here right now.
Gertie, who is it? Can I take a message?
It’s the school. Shall they call back later?

alvo.gramatica: rent a car for… · return it by… · with a full tank
alvo.foco: alugar um carro com rent… for… e return it by… (per day, insurance, tank, license, return, full)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende o aluguel: I want to rent a car for a week. I will return it on Friday. Return it with a full tank.
falas: I want to rent a car for a week.
It is forty dollars per day.
Do I need insurance?

alvo.gramatica: totally · literally · super + adjetivo (intensificadores informais)
alvo.foco: falar como os jovens com totally, literally e super (slang, trend, outfit, gossip, squad, vibe)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a exagerar: That is totally cool. It is literally the best. This outfit is super cute.
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a film, so the context changes how we read the scene.
That makes the intention clearer.

alvo.gramatica: Which line goes to…? · It goes to…
alvo.foco: usar ônibus e metrô com Which line goes to… e It goes to… (get on, get off, stop, fare, line, transfer)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende o transporte: Which line goes to the museum? Line two goes to the museum. How much is the fare?
falas: Excuse me. Which line goes to the museum?
Line two goes to the museum.
How much is the fare?

alvo.gramatica: would + verbo (hábito no passado)
alvo.foco: lembrar hábitos de infância com would + verbo (used to, every summer, when I was, bike, street, play)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a lembrar: Every summer, we would play in the street. I would ride my bike every day.
falas: Do you remember our summers?
Every summer, we would play outside.
I would ride my bike every day.

alvo.gramatica: If I were…, I would… (segunda condicional)
alvo.foco: imaginar com If I were… I would… (zoo, giraffe, kangaroo, elephant, cage, boss)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a imaginar: If I were the boss of the zoo, I would be happy. If I were a keeper, I would feed the giraffe. If I were you, I would watch the ka
falas: If I were the boss of the zoo, I would be happy.
What would you do all day?
If I were a keeper, I would feed the giraffe.

alvo.gramatica: I love your… · You look + adjetivo · Thanks, you too
alvo.foco: elogiar com I love your…, You look… e Thanks, you too (lovely, amazing, smart, beautiful, brave, voice)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a elogiar: I love your voice. You look lovely. You are so smart. Thanks, you too!
falas: I love your voice.
Thank you! You look lovely today.
Thanks, you too!

alvo.gramatica: not only… but also…
alvo.foco: somar qualidades com not only… but also… (horse, groom, cart, hay, fast, strong)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a somar: You are not only gentle but also strong. John is not only kind but also wise. The cart is not only heavy but also old.
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a song, so the context changes how we read the scene.
That makes the intention clearer.

alvo.gramatica: in + tempo (daqui a): in a minute · in an hour
alvo.foco: dizer daqui a quanto tempo com in a minute, in an hour e in a week (wristwatch, millennium, leap year, fortnight, calendar date, planner)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende o futuro próximo: I will be there in a minute. The meeting starts in an hour. We travel in a fortnight.
falas: When does the meeting start?
It starts in an hour.
Where are you?

alvo.gramatica: a kilo of · half a kilo of · a dozen
alvo.foco: pedir por peso com a kilo of, half a kilo of e a dozen (tomato, potato, egg, cherry, pork, market)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a pesar: I want a kilo of tomatoes. Half a kilo of potatoes, please. A dozen eggs, please.
falas: Good morning! I want a kilo of tomatoes.
Here you are. Anything else?
Half a kilo of potatoes, please.
